prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1211; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Sorry, I'm not comfortable giving my full name on a recording just yet. You can refer to me as the driver of the silver sedan.

Q: That's fine for now. Can you describe what happened when you were leaving the parking spot?

A: I had just backed out slowly, checking my mirrors like always. A pickup came down the aisle faster than I expected and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. I braked hard, and the jolt threw me against the steering wheel and then the door frame.

Q: Did you have any part of your body injured in the collision?

A: Yes. I put my left arm out to brace myself, and my wrist hit the console. The doctor at the urgent care clinic said it's a fracture. They put me in a splint and told me I'll need to see a specialist.

Q: Do you know which way the pickup was traveling, and was it moving before you started to back out?

A: It was coming from the far end of the row, moving toward the exit. I didn't see it until it was already close. I can't say for certain how fast it was going.

Q: Did anyone witness the collision, or did you take any photographs of the scene?

A: A man in the next row got out of his car to look, but I didn't get his contact details. I took a few photos of both vehicles before I left the lot.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment beyond the urgent care visit?

A: Not yet. I have a follow-up appointment scheduled with an orthopedic specialist, and I'm waiting on the imaging results.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my car repaired properly and my medical bills taken care of. I've been without my usual transportation for a while now, and it's been stressful.

Q: Understood. This concludes the recorded statement. Thank you.

A: Thank you.
